title: Zay'z Bow
description: This mod adds lots of arc for lots of power
body:
**Zay'z Bow** is a **Minecraft mod** that brings a whole new level to archery! 🏹✨
Craft powerful bows from **Iron**, **Gold**, **Diamond**, and **Netherite**, each with unique stats and abilities. But that’s not all – the Fletching Table finally has a purpose! Use it to **craft**, **upgrade**, and **customize your bows**, turning every shot into a precision strike. Whether you’re a novice archer or a master marksman, Zayz Bow adds depth, strategy, and fun to every ranged battle!
